title: E-Commerce Marketing Executive
description:
Ecommerce Marketing Executive

Location: North Oxfordshire / Hybrid (1-2 days per week in the office)
Salary: £30,000-£32,000 DOE

About the Role

Robert Half are working with an international organisation to recruit an Ecommerce Marketing Executive to join its growing digital content team.

This is an exciting opportunity for an organised and proactive ecommerce professional to support the creation, management and optimisation of digital content across Amazon, and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) channels throughout Europe.

You'll play a key role in bringing products to market, supporting new product launches, managing digital merchandising assets and ensuring content is accurate, engaging and delivered on time. Working closely with internal teams, agencies and European stakeholders, you'll help deliver a consistent and high-quality customer experience across multiple digital channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Create and manage digital merchandising assets, product imagery, carousel assets and enhanced product content.
- Manage content deployment, updates and refreshes across Amazon, and DTC platforms.
- Support new product launches, coordinating content, assets, timelines and deployment schedules.
- Work with creative and internal teams to ensure content meets brand, retailer and channel requirements.
- Support localisation and adaptation of content across European markets.
- Maintain digital asset libraries, content systems and supporting documentation.
- Conduct regular content audits and proactively identify and resolve content issues or inconsistencies.
- Support content optimisation using ecommerce best practice, performance insights and customer data.
- Work collaboratively with marketing, product, category and other cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time.
- Contribute to improving content processes and the overall efficiency of digital content deployment.

About You

We're looking for someone with around 1-3 years' experience in ecommerce, digital content, digital marketing or ecommerce operations who is keen to develop their career in a fast-paced, international environment.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience managing content across ecommerce or retailer platforms.
- Amazon Vendor Central experience.
- Salesforce experience.
- Experience with retailer content platforms and ecommerce systems.
- Experience supporting product launches and digital content deployment.
- Experience working with Adobe Creative Suite.
- A good understanding of ecommerce content and online customer journeys.
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience working with European stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

Experience with Amazon A+ or Premium A+ Content, PIM/DAM systems such as InRiver, localisation/translation workflows or content optimisation would be advantageous.

What We're Looking For

You'll be highly organised, process-driven and proactive, with a genuine interest in ecommerce and digital retail. You'll enjoy working in a collaborative environment, managing multiple priorities and taking ownership of projects from planning through to completion.

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join an international business and gain broad exposure to ecommerce content, digital merchandising, product launches and European digital operations.

You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple digital channels, collaborate with teams across Europe and make a real contribution to how products are presented and experienced online.

Apply now through Robert Half to find out more.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training.
